note: Team judge weights fit to 8,072 usable real AD games (of 8,752 pulled) from 30 top players (lab/data/top-players.json) via Steam/OpenDota, logistic regression. 5-fold CV: 67.0% on the draft alone, 71.9% with a term for which side has more of the top players (topSide, left out of the draft score). Hand-set weights.json picks 66.1%. Best model in ml/experiment.py: draft features + per-player skill, 72.7% 5-fold. Agrees with 14 of Brandon's 21 decided team drafts without seeing them. Weights are per raw feature, scale 1.
